faq.q: What is the Duke 556 in GTA 6?
faq.a: An assault rifle named by IGN. IGN reported that the AR-15 lookalike rifle seen in earlier material was confirmed as the Duke 556 Assault Rifle during the Extended Look gameplay reveal.

faq.q: Can the Duke 556 be customized in GTA 6?
faq.a: IGN reported that it appears to be highly customizable, and said it has been shown with an extended magazine, several different sights, different stocks and a suppressor. The full attachment list has not been published.

faq.q: What real gun is the Duke 556 based on?
faq.a: IGN described it as an AR-15 pattern rifle. That is the outlet matching a shape to a familiar weapon. Rockstar builds its guns from invented manufacturers and has named no real firearm.

faq.q: How do players get the Duke 556 in GTA 6?
faq.a: No price, shop or unlock method has been published. Rockstar has released no weapons list, so how the rifle is obtained in the finished game is not known.

faq.q: How much damage does the Duke 556 do?
faq.a: No damage figure or rate of fire has been published for it. The game has not released. Numbers carried over from assault rifles in Grand Theft Auto V do not apply and are not listed here.
